features: Explosion-proof (316L stainless steel, ATEX/IECEx) thermal-only network bullet camera (uncooled VOx 640x512 detector, 17 um pixel pitch)
25 mm thermal lens, F1.0, 24.55 x 19.75 field of view

release_notes: Explosion-proof (316L stainless steel, ATEX/IECEx) thermal-only network bullet camera with a 640x512 uncooled VOx detector (17 um, NETD < 40 mK), 25 mm F1.0 lens and dual-band temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C and 0 to 550 C) for hazardous industrial sites. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.
